top_stories.title: Microsoft’s September Identity Batch Proves the Authentication Gap Is Not an Open-Source Problem
top_stories.summary: Microsoft disclosed nine vulnerabilities outside its standard Patch Tuesday cycle on September 3, 2026, including two rated CVSS 10.0: CVE-2026-83711, an authorization bypass in Azure AD B2C, and CVE-2026-70352. The flaws directly affect Microsoft's identity platform, targeting authentication and authorization mechanisms critical to IAM infrastructure.

top_stories.title: FreeIPA Flaw Chain Lets Anonymous Clients Create Reusable Administrator Credentials
top_stories.summary: A vulnerability chain in FreeIPA allows unauthenticated clients to create arbitrary Kerberos identities and gain administrator group membership in Linux domain environments. The attack combines a FreeIPA flaw with a second vulnerability in the 389 Directory Server (LDAP backend), as disclosed by Red Hat.

top_stories.title: Threat actors are giving AI agents a bigger role in cyberattacks
top_stories.summary: Google Threat Intelligence Group's Q3 2026 AI Threat Tracker reports that threat actors are increasingly using AI agents to automate cyberattacks, including credential harvesting campaigns. Mandiant incident response data documents a six-hour credential theft campaign in Q2 2026 where AI systems handled multiple connected attack tasks with minimal human involvement.

top_stories.title: Autonomous AI Agents Compromise Thousands of Credentials in Under Six Hours
top_stories.summary: A financially motivated threat group used an autonomous multi-agent AI framework to conduct a large-scale credential harvesting campaign, compromising thousands of credentials in under six hours. Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) observed the attack, which highlights the use of AI to accelerate credential theft operations at scale.

top_stories.title: Fake IT Calls Target Executives in Microsoft 365 Data Theft and Extortion Attacks
top_stories.summary: A threat cluster is targeting Microsoft 365 executives through vishing attacks impersonating IT help desks, combined with adversary-in-the-middle token theft and residential-proxy sign-ins to steal data and extort victims. The attack chain specifically focuses on bypassing MFA protections by stealing session tokens rather than credentials, targeting directors, vice presidents, and other senior staff.

news.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 1,000 Security Holes
news.summary: Microsoft released a record-breaking patch batch addressing at least 974 security vulnerabilities across Windows and other software. AI is being credited for accelerating vulnerability discovery, though security experts note organizations are struggling to prioritize and deploy the high volume of monthly fixes.

news.title: JSCeal Malware Can Bypass Google Authentication Using Stolen Session Cookies
news.summary: Check Point Research has analyzed JSCeal, a V8 JavaScript malware capable of bypassing Google authentication by stealing session cookies. The malware features credential harvesting, traffic interception, and surveillance capabilities, with payloads protected by multiple obfuscation techniques including RC4-encrypted strings and control-flow flattening.

news.title: The End of the Authentication Gap: Microsoft’s SSPR Enforcement
news.summary: Microsoft Entra ID will terminate the use of unregistered directory contact data for self-service password reset (SSPR) as of September 7, 2026. Mobile numbers, business phones, and secondary emails not explicitly registered as authentication methods will no longer be usable for SSPR, requiring organizations to ensure users have properly registered authentication methods.

news.title: Okta Jumps 20% as AI-Driven Security Fears Fuel a Beat-and-Raise Quarter
news.summary: Okta reported fiscal Q2 results beating estimates, with adjusted EPS of $1.05 versus $0.97 expected and revenue rising 11% to $805 million. The strong results drove a share price surge of up to 29%, with the company citing AI-driven security concerns as a growth driver.

news.title: Attackers Breached JetBrains Cadence via Unpatched TeamCity, Extracting AWS Credentials
news.summary: Threat actors exploited a critical vulnerability in JetBrains TeamCity to breach the Cadence environment and extract AWS credentials. JetBrains is urging all Cadence users to immediately revoke and rotate any credentials and secrets used in their Cadence executions.

news.title: zitadel v4.17.3
news.summary: Zitadel released version 4.17.3 of its open-source identity and access management platform. The platform supports SSO, MFA, passkeys, OIDC, SAML, SCIM, and multi-tenant access control.

news.title: Pathlock Recognized as a Representative Vendor in the 2026 Gartner® Market Guide for Identity Governance and Administration
news.summary: Pathlock has been recognized as a Representative Vendor in the 2026 Gartner Market Guide for Identity Governance and Administration. The recognition positions Pathlock within the IGA market landscape, which Gartner describes as covering emerging risks and opportunities in the evolving sector.

news.title: Old, Unpatched Flaws Give Attackers Access to Philippines Nuclear Agency
news.summary: Threat actors exploited unpatched vulnerabilities in ownCloud to breach the Philippines Nuclear Agency, stealing reactor databases, personnel records, and credential stores. The attack leveraged commodity vulnerabilities to gain initial access, resulting in the compromise of sensitive credentials and identity-related data.

news.title: Attackers Pounce on Critical Artifactory Bug Following Disclosure
news.summary: A critical authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-82329) has been disclosed in JFrog Artifactory, allowing attackers to gain admin-level access on affected systems. Attackers are actively exploiting the flaw following its public disclosure.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million U.S. and Canadian drivers licenses, with evidence suggesting the data was siphoned from a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has opened an official inquiry into the source of the leaked images.

news.title: Anthropic Users Hit by Infostealer Attacks, Session Thefts
news.summary: A threat actor deployed infostealer malware to steal session tokens and gain unauthorized access to Claude (Anthropic) user accounts. The attack targeted session cookies/tokens to bypass authentication, enabling account takeover without requiring credentials.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Connor Riley Moucka, a 26-year-old Canadian man, pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges related to hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake's cloud data storage platform. The attacks involved unauthorized access to Snowflake customer accounts, largely enabled by stolen credentials and the absence of multi-factor authentication on victim accounts.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA conducted a postmortem after a contractor accidentally exposed dozens of internal credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, in a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management failures and gaps in secrets detection practices relevant to IAM and privileged access management teams.
